card.name: Words just before a list of answers
card.fires_on: A verb or quantifier right after a question word or superlative (what helps, most effective, include) where the next words name items in a list or an answer.

modes.label: Question lead-ins
modes.description: The verb after "What" in a symptom or interview question, before the answer.

modes.label: Superlative or list lead-ins
modes.description: Words like most, include, or at that set up a ranked or enumerated answer.
